sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: On July 13, 2026, Tbilisi City Hall issued a permit to dismantle Rike Park's tube-shaped Music Theater & Exhibition Hall . The complex, designed by the Italian firm Studio Fuksas , was never officially opened since its completion in 2012, around the same time as the firm's Tbilisi Public Service Hall . The design has been a source of controversy between authorities and citizens since its commission in 2011, when it was built during the government of the United National Movement (UNM), and was suspended after the change of government in 2012. The two structures, often referred to as the "Rike Tubes," were originally intended to house a music theater and exhibition space but remain to this day without any official use.
